description: The data that the Python package produces and the Java executor consumes. Relative coordinates are relative to the anchor of the run. A block state is written as a vanilla block identifier plus a flat map of state properties; an absent property is a wildcard that the verification accepts in its default value.

context.description: The world, the anchor and the capabilities of the request.

world.server: string, required when worldUid is absent; host:port of the server, IPv6 in brackets
world.worldUid: string; the current identity from capabilities, required for a local save; server and dimension remain supported for remote worlds

anchor.x: integer, required; the world x of the front left bottom cell of the house
anchor.y: integer, required; the world y of the floor level of the house
anchor.z: integer, required; the world z of the front left bottom cell of the house

context.siteBounds: optional {width, depth}; the surveyed footprint, with one extra block on each side for exterior access

capabilities.commandLevel: integer, optional; the operator level the client has on the server

resources.description: Optional snapshot supplied by the caller
resources.inventory: map of usable main-inventory item IDs to positive counts
resources.canSupplyBlocks: boolean; the caller has a way to supply supported vanilla blocks on demand
resources.canHangPaintings: boolean, optional; the executor supports verified painting placement and the caller can use summon

startOptions.mode: string; blueprint_only or text_to_blueprint; the default is blueprint_only when a blueprint is given and text_to_blueprint otherwise
startOptions.allowCommands: boolean, default true; the builder may supply inventory with /give
startOptions.strictPhysical: boolean, default false; when true /give is disabled as well
startOptions.sitePreparation: boolean, default true; the mandatory PREPARING phase
startOptions.continuousRecovery: boolean, default false; recoverable incidents keep the run resumable and can trigger a local blueprint revision
startOptions.restoreRunId: string, optional; paired with restoreProjectId when the caller continues a saved run after the client restarts
startOptions.restoreProjectId: string, optional; stable project identity from the saved run

expert.providerProfile: string, optional; the name of the configured provider profile
expert.deadlineMillis: integer, default 30000; zero waits until completion or cancellation
expert.incidentBudget: integer, default 3; zero disables expert calls; in continuous recovery positive values permit calls for new evidence without a per-run count limit

startOptions.templateId: string, optional; the id of a template of spec/house-catalog.json
startOptions.palette: integer, optional; the index of the palette

blueprint.revision: integer; increases with every accepted change of the mandatory requirements
blueprint.description: string; the original text of the request

requirements.mandatory: array of strings; the requirements that the result has to satisfy
requirements.assumptions: array of strings; the decisions that the request did not state
requirements.conflicts: array of objects {code, detail}; a conflict of the request is a diagnosable result and never a silent choice

cells.description: The occupied cells of the house and of its permanent site preparation.
cells.block: string; the vanilla identifier of the block, for example minecraft:oak_stairs
cells.state: object, optional; the flat map of the state properties, for example {facing: north, half: bottom}
cells.kind: string; one of structure, furniture, decoration, site_preparation, access
cells.dependsOn: array of strings, optional; the ids of the cells that must stand before this cell
cells.id: string, optional; a stable id of the cell inside the blueprint

blueprint.accessLevels: optional array of relative standing heights of occupiable floors
blueprint.accessAreas: optional array of {name, y, area, roomType?}; area contains inclusive [x1,z1,x2,z2] rectangles
blueprint.circulationClearance: optional array of {x, y, z}; points must also belong to requiredAir
blueprint.scaffoldAccess: optional array of up to eight preferred exterior work columns {x, y:0, z} relative to the origin; keep the house and approach clear
blueprint.paintings: optional array of {x, y, z, facing, variant}; one-block vanilla paintings with solid backing, outside circulationClearance

multiBlockPairs.description: The cells of one multi block object, for example a door or a bed.

entrance.facing: string; north, east, south or west
entrance.approachCells: array of {x, y, z}; the cells that have to be reachable

materials.description: The item ledger of the house. The materials of the scaffolding, of the platforms and of the tools are counted separately.
materials.item: string; the vanilla identifier of the item

cleanup.description: The temporary infrastructure of the plan. Every entry has to be removed before READY.
cleanup.removeAfter: string, optional; the id of the cell or of the phase after which it may go

restoration.description: The obligations to restore the cells that the module changed on purpose.

expertRequest.description: The request of the executor to the LLM expert. The executor sends it without holding the game input and with a deadline.
expertRequest.transport: The executor starts the Python package as a subprocess and writes one JSON object on its standard input; the package answers with one JSON object on its standard output. The provider of the model is a configuration of the package and never of the executor.
expertRequest.permitGeneration: integer; the generation of the permit that the executor holds

incident.kind: string; for example access_lost, world_plan_mismatch, repeated_no_progress, support_removed

worldSnapshot.cells: array of {x, y, z, block, state}; the local observation around the goal
worldSnapshot.known: array of {x, y, z}; the cells that were not loaded or not observed
worldSnapshot.revision: string; the identity of the snapshot

ownership.availableActions: array drawn from place_block, break_block, move, observe, scaffold_access

attemptLedger.description: The relevant records only: the successful and the failed attempts of the current goal and the neighbouring routes.

resources.scaffoldAccess: optional array of observed grounded columns {base, stance, blocksNeeded}; coordinates are absolute

plan.description: The current plan of the run, so that the expert may reorder the work.
plan.steps: array of objects {id, kind, cells, dependsOn, cleanupIds}

expertResponse.outcome: string; one of repair, request_observation, blocked

repair.description: A verifiable change of the work plan. It never changes the mandatory requirements of the house.
repair.steps: array of objects {id, kind, cells, dependsOn, cleanupIds, note}
repair.scaffold_access: one step with an advertised stance as its only cell and empty cleanupIds and route; subsequent goal changes depend on this step
repair.route: array of {x, y, z}; the proposed route of the access, when the incident is about the access
repair.expects: object; the observable effect that proves the repair, for example {block: minecraft:air, at: {x, y, z}}

observationRequest.description: A concrete observation that the executor has to provide before the work may continue.

blocked.safeFallback: string; the authorized local fallback, when there is one
